scope: Provisional comparison of seven individually reviewed drafts only; not a within-set or collection-wide acceptance

observations.evidence: Both use a left circular gear/chip, a small rightward black arrow, and a filled object at right. At 30x18 the chip and gear simplify similarly and the file/tag differences shrink; this cross-file pair is too structurally similar for the requested differentiation.
observations.action: Redesign at least one; compare actual replacement at all sizes.

observations.evidence: Both have an arrow leading to the same file silhouette at right. The left shapes differ (chip versus converging branches), but the common layout and reduced arrow/file detail warrant comparison with the final five options.
observations.action: Decide within-set distinctness after replacement artwork exists.

observations.evidence: The eye and barred I16 label remain visible in the enlarged 30x18 preview. Exact type readability at native size must be judged alongside the other integer widths and signed/unsigned designs; these are not yet available.
observations.action: Retain the reviewed master provisionally and compare with all typed getters and setters.

observations.evidence: The tag and heartbeat line remain distinct at 30x18, but a pulse can imply health monitoring while this VI returns the tag status/error code.
observations.action: Review whether the symbol conveys the status call accurately and compare with other status/error icons.

limitations: Only seven available drafts are shown. Most collection candidates do not exist; this is not the required final cross-file review.
